name: @red-cup-engineering/systemd-unit-inventory-observation-service
description: Read-only systemd unit inventory observation across every host in the Union swarm, for asset bookkeeping.

x-agentic-metro-enterprise.admission: one exact --host (the literal string 'local' or a bare SSH destination); returns that host's systemd unit and timer inventory as JSON
x-agentic-metro-enterprise.refusal: any systemctl verb other than list-units/list-timers, any unit-file content beyond what systemctl itself reports, any SSH credential or key material, and any host value containing shell metacharacters
